cuda_changes: Adopted fixed dispatch; native strided inputs including input-reuse packing, observer-visible shared activation, and seven-row reuse with unchanged per-shape K-slice arithmetic. Optional caller-owned W4 partial sums and arrival counters isolate early DFlash2 context preparation; arithmetic and default scratch ownership remain unchanged. Optional direct rank-packet MHC consumer preserves canonical FP32 sum and BF16 input rounding. Optional direct TX-slot output resolves its address after the producer dependency and system-fences every final writer; W4/input-reuse arithmetic is unchanged. Qualified wide-row input reuse packs each activation once without changing the ordinary MMA/reduction; the packed-input specialization remains separate from direct TX-slot production. K=7 C1 output and paired-query projections keep their original K slices inside one CTA, eliminating global partial/counter traffic; K=1536/2048/3072 specializations retain the original accumulation and rounding order. Bound K7 C1 projections load W4 vectors and scales into registers, prefetching the next K block while preserving every MMA and split reduction; static shared memory holds only the partial sums. C1 DSA query readers share one grid with independent output tile ranges and the same three-slice reductions. Register weight loads retain the original cg cache policy and statically sized K-slice loops are unrolled.
